findings.claim: TestStartPeek's only mismatch case (home-mismatch-refuses) differs in BOTH claude-home and codex-home, so the per-home identity check at main.go:248 is unpinned: rewriting `id.ClaudeHome == claudeHome && id.CodexHome == codexHome` to `||`, or dropping either comparison, keeps the suite green while a peek serving a matching claude-home but a different codex-home (or vice versa) would be reused.
findings.evidence: Re-read main.go:245-258 and main_test.go:47-110. Cases: identity-match-reuses (both equal -> true under &&, ||, or a single comparison), home-mismatch-refuses (both differ -> false under &&, ||, or a single comparison), non-peek-listener-refuses and the two spawn cases never reach the comparison. No case sets exactly one home equal, so every weakening of the conjunction passes. go test ./cmd/configserver/... is green at head.
findings.fix: Add two cases to TestStartPeek: healthzPort("/home/a/.claude", "/home/b/.codex") with claudeHome /home/a/.claude + codexHome /home/a/.codex -> false, and the mirrored claude-home-only mismatch -> false.

findings.claim: No CheckPolicy test modifies an editable-scope rule to bind an unsanctioned verifier, so the bindsVerifier=true argument for the "modified" class (policy.go:373) is unpinned: changing it to false keeps the suite green while a gated branch could then rebind ACDSL-GOLANG-100 from gofmt to any verifier outside verifier_allowlist unreported.
findings.evidence: Re-read policy.go:82-109 and 368-375 plus every CheckPolicy test in policy_test.go. TestCheckPolicyGatedVerifierAllowlist (228-244) exercises only an ADDED rule (ACDSL-GOLANG-101). TestCheckPolicyGatedChangedMarkerLine (216-226) modifies ACDSL-PLAN-100, which fails the editable-scope check at line 100 before the verifier check at line 104 is reached. TestRuleDelta exercises ruleDelta only, not classViolations. So no test reaches line 104 via the modified class; flipping the literal at 373 leaves every assertion intact.
findings.fix: Extend TestCheckPolicyGatedVerifierAllowlist with a case that rewrites policyBaseGolangRule to bind `rogue` (same id ACDSL-GOLANG-100) and asserts `rule ACDSL-GOLANG-100 binds verifier "rogue" outside the sanctioned set`.
